scope: Drill of FUN_00cd8990 (1978-byte large class init, 18 cclosure pushes per the alt binding recon pass). Discovery: this is the Lua Game Engine (LGE) bootstrap function. It (a) embeds and loads a literal Lua wrapper script that redefines `require` and adds `__lge_isAlive`/`__lge_returnNil`, (b) registers 13 named C global functions including 4 Lua stdlib OVERRIDES, (c) sets up the `_onLoop` userdata metatable with 4 metamethods, (d) installs the LGE root table's `__newindex` cclosure. Methodology: new Ghidra DumpAddrOperandsInFunc.java utility scans every instruction operand recovering both string args and impl-function VAs, defeating the decompiler-arg-strip issue that blocked the alt binding recon pass. Two caller functions FUN_00cd9d80 and FUN_00cd9e80 are simple shim factories that just CALL FUN_00cd8990 (inheritance pair as hypothesized in recon).

embeddedBootstrapScript.content:
require = nil
function require(filename, listener, errorNotify)
  if _luaGameEngineRequire(filename, listener, errorNotify) == true then
    _luaGameEngineLoad(filename, listener)
  end
  _luaGameEngineRequireEnd()
end
function __lge_isAlive()
  return false
end
function __lge_returnNil()
  return nil
end
collectgarbage = nil

namedGlobals.name: _pcall
namedGlobals.notes: Registered via the sequence at 0x00cd8fc7-0x00cd8ff1: PUSH "pcall"; pushstring; PUSH "_pcall"; pushstring; pushvalue; setglobal. This renames the stock Lua pcall (FUN_00DCxxxx area) to _pcall BEFORE the new override is installed. So _pcall is the original pcall, exposed under the underscore alias.

namedGlobals.name: _clock
namedGlobals.notes: SAME impl VA as _time. Likely a cclosure with upvalue discriminator or single function that branches on the calling-name passed via the Lua stack.

onLoopMetatable.notes: Userdata-style metatable for `_onLoop`. Pattern matches the d2fxxx cluster attribution pass's 5-template metatable cluster (uses the same .rdata metamethod-name table at 0x0110ea7c..0x0110eabc). The zero caller napi survey findings pass's client-architecture 'The bound N-API surface is broader than shipped-script usage' had _onLoop listed as zero-shipped-caller; this clarifies why - scripts interact with the userdata via metamethods, not via the literal `_onLoop` name.

lgeRootMetamethod.notes: The LGE root table's __newindex metamethod. FUN_00d099b0 was one of the 14 unresolved templates from recon (categorized as parametric_template with 'Body has 3 FUN_00447260 literal-string calls' note). The lge bootstrap attribution pass attributes its role: it is the __newindex handler for the LGE bootstrap table itself, intercepting all global-write attempts after the bootstrap script runs.

FUN_00cd9d80.notes: Shim factory; allocates+initializes some structure then calls FUN_00cd8990 to register the LGE on the Lua state.

FUN_00cd9e80.notes: Sibling shim factory; same shape as FUN_00cd9d80 minus the FUN_00447260 string-literal call. The inheritance-pair hypothesis from the alt binding recon pass is confirmed.

luaStdlibFnHelpers.FUN_00cf3360: lua_pushstring (push C string onto Lua stack)
luaStdlibFnHelpers.FUN_00cf32e0: lua_pushcclosure (push C function as cclosure with N upvalues)
luaStdlibFnHelpers.FUN_00cf32c0: lua_pushvalue (or rotate; pushes copy of stack entry)
luaStdlibFnHelpers.FUN_00cf3400: lua_settable (assigns value at -1 to key at -2 in table at -3)
luaStdlibFnHelpers.FUN_00cf3a50: lua_setglobal (assigns value at -1 to global at name in stack)
